newsitem.title: USA: Security Federal Savings conversion to stock OK'd.
newsitem.headline: Security Federal Savings conversion to stock OK'd.

text.p: Security Federal Savings Bank of McMinnville said Friday the Office of Thrift Supervision has approved its conversion from a federally-chartered mutual savings bank to a federally-chartered stock savings bank.
The bank said as a result, it has formed a holding company, Security Bancorp Inc, to hold all outstanding capital stock of Security Federal.
The holding company will offer up to 379,500 shares of its common stock for $10 a share, the bank said, adding that a subscription offering for the stock expires June 17.
